At step n, the modified stored energy weights E(n)^2 by the electric diagonal and H(n-1/2)*H(n+1/2) by permeability. Separately report the conventional energy with centered H. No solver updates, checkpoint state or communication counts change. The explicit development tool tools/test_diagonal_field_energy_mpi.py uses no GS and tests field MPI1/2, positive dielectric/magnetic backgrounds, scalar/diagonal LD and direct restart from step32. It executes calculations; it is not an input-only management-node checker. Off-diagonal background observation includes the constitutive boundary exchange from the actual interpolation. LD subpixel observation uses the actual smoothed background and dispersive response. Yee E/H samples differ by half a step. `field_modified_*` uses the cross-product energy preserved by the discrete update; `field_physical_*` uses time-centered H in the conventional energy. Both residuals are retained. Closure of the discrete balance alone does not establish continuum energy accuracy. With the molecule driven after own-vacuum-field subtraction, add the removed vacuum self-field work to the field change, outward flux, LD work and molecular internal-energy change. Do not subtract zero-field drift. The short C2H2 development test gave an accumulated discrete field residual of about 9.1e-15 Hartree and a joint residual of about 5.9e-8 Hartree, about 0.70% of molecular work. Normalization by the much larger incident field would hide this matter error. This is not a general physical-accuracy certification. Real FDTD domain tests also passed with two partitions separately along x, y and z (outer MPI6: two field ranks plus one bookkeeping rank per context). Molecular saved arrays exactly equal the one-field-rank results; six-face integrated quantities agree within reduction-order roundoff. The development tool `tools/test_molecular_feedback_mpi.py` accepts `--field-grid NX NY NZ` and requires `2*(NX*NY*NZ+1)` total ranks. Rejection/retry with the same two-partition grid exactly matches continuous execution, including every saved array and six-face record. Electronic rollback now uses a direct live savepoint. This is separate from multi-node or large-decomposition evidence. With diagonal background permittivity, off-diagonal LD pole strengths are supported: work uses the complete component currents, including cross-component response. Off-diagonal background permittivity is accounted for using the actual background interpolation and a separate constitutive boundary contribution. For non-diagonal backgrounds, `constitutive_outward_energy` is the outward-positive constitutive boundary exchange. It is separate from `outward_energy`, the six-face Poynting flux. Old/new field energies include the cross contribution; both residuals include its boundary exchange. The locally assigned cross energy need not be positive by itself. The current Fortran/C step observation has 19 components, ending with constitutive exchange and Ohmic work; the summary has 12 components. Explicitly rebuild older libraries from the current sources. Only non-diagonal background observation adds interpolation halo traffic and preparation-failure agreement within the owning field group. Ordinary time evolution, application-wide communication and checkpoint state are unchanged. Discrete balance is not a physical convergence certificate. LD subpixel smoothing uses the same 19-component budget, with diagonal weights recovered from actual update coefficients and cross energy/exchange from the spatially varying background interpolation. Complete LD currents enter `ld_work`. The observer does not substitute original bulk coefficients. This checks discrete balance of the reference-frequency smoothed model. It is not evidence of broadband material accuracy or curved-interface grid convergence. Cells that fall back to original coefficients are observed with those actual coefficients. Inspect applied/fallback sample counts and reference errors in `salmonpy-subpixel-summary.json`. SBE/TDDFT are not smoothed. `ohmic_work` is the nonnegative energy dissipated in each accepted step: dt times cell volume times the sum of sigma E_mid squared, where E_mid averages old/new edge fields. Fortran recovers sigma from the actual electric/current update coefficients after removing the implicit LD contribution. Only subtraction roundoff is treated as zero. Keep Ohmic dissipation separate from `ld_work` (work on dispersive polarization, not solely irreversible heat), external-current work, six-face Poynting flux and constitutive exchange. Both residuals and the summary include all terms. For zero-conductivity configurations the extra evaluation is skipped, existing observations are preserved and `ohmic_work=0`. There is no additional communication or change to propagation/checkpoint state. Explicitly rebuild the field runtime and lightweight kernel together. ## Molecular TDDFT performance mode `initial.new_state(dt=dt, execution_mode="performance")` selects performance mode for an E-driven molecular worker. The default is `"checked"`. Performance mode skips per-step finite-value diagnostics and automatic recovery. Shape, capacity, response type, energy freshness, and explicit save/restore validation remain enabled. `step_fields` still validates its field contract. Automatic retry after failure is not guaranteed. Snapshots do not select an execution mode: the receiving state retains its mode, including the candidate worker used for direct disk restore. Compare against checked mode before use. This option does not put the surrounding FDTD coupling into performance mode. ### Molecular outer-coupling performance mode `MolecularFeedback(..., execution_mode="performance")` omits additional finite scans of reported field/current arrays. Field and molecular modes are independent: select `NativeEHField(..., execution_mode="performance")` and `initial.new_state(..., execution_mode="performance")` separately. The `molecular_feedback` sample's `--execution-mode performance` selects all three; the default is checked. The trial → field restore → accepted update algorithm still requires both field backups and the molecular savepoint. Own-vacuum subtraction, predicted/accepted drive agreement, clocks, MPI ordering and explicit validation callbacks remain enabled. After a callback rejects an interval, check `StepRecoveryError.original_preserved` and cleanup errors before retrying. This does not promise general recovery from process termination, broken MPI or NaN. Direct disk restore candidates retain the receiving worker's execution mode. ### Public performance evidence and coordinated disk restart Pass an executable-matching validation record to `load_isolated_runtime(EXECUTABLE, VALIDATION_JSON)`. The measured record includes `execution_modes=["checked", "performance"]`, the performance response protocol, public-entry checks, independent states, reference comparison, live restoration and process-exit direct restoration. It records a short C2H2/PZ integration regression, not physical certification for arbitrary molecules. Developer tool `tools/validate_isolated_performance_runtime.py` reuses existing reference data without SCF or GS copies. Run the public `molecular_feedback` sample in separate save and resume jobs with identical executable, inputs, dt, step capacity and MPI layout. For six ranks, use `--field-grid 2 1 1 --steps 64 --execution-mode performance --ld` and first `--checkpoint STATE_DIR --stop-after 32`, then `--resume STATE_DIR` with a new output directory. Both FDTD states are saved at step 32 and the molecule at step 31. Resume verifies actual Fortran field indices and the molecular index. `restore_statistics.updates` must be 0; only 32 new molecular updates are needed to reach field step 64. Inspect `restored_steps`, `restore_statistics` and `molecular_execution_mode` in the sample output. Frame history is for analysis and is never replayed to restore numerical state. Changed MPI layouts or executable versions are outside this checkpoint guarantee.

# 孤立系TDDFT：E入力と双極子

PZ・固定イオン・非偏極・スカラー擬ポテンシャル・中点伝播を、明示的な別プロセスで使います。結晶のTDDFT/SBEは従来どおりA駆動です。返す量は電荷双極子であり、電流密度ではありません。格子・時間刻み・計算箱の収束は利用者が確認します。

## 計算プログラムと初期状態

```python
from salmonpy.isolated_tddft import load_isolated_runtime, IsolatedTDDFTInitialState

runtime = load_isolated_runtime('salmon', 'validation/report.json')
with IsolatedTDDFTInitialState.from_salmon(
        'existing-bundle', 'rt.inp', runtime=runtime,
        max_steps=100, threads=1, timeout=60) as initial:
    with initial.new_state(dt=.02) as state:
        saved = state.savepoint()
        frame = state.step([0., 0., 1.e-5])
        print(frame.time, frame.dipole, frame.electron_number)
        state.restore_savepoint(saved)  # 同じワーカーへ直接コピー、時間発展なし
        state.release_savepoint(saved)
```

E・時刻は原子単位、双極子はe·bohrです。`dipole` はイオンと電子を合わせた全電荷双極子、`electronic_change` は電子双極子変化です。配列は読み取り専用です。初期E・時刻はゼロ。`new_state(position=...)` は場を評価する位置（既定(0,0,0) bohr）を指定し、分子座標の移動・回転は行いません。

読込みは64 KiB以下のローカル検証記録と、実行ファイルのSHA256を照合します。現行の記録形式は `salmonpy.isolated-worker-validation/5`。数値応答はE3の9成分のままですが、同一プロセス・時間発展追加0回の直接復元と、古い退避の拒否の実証を必須にしています。旧revision4以前の記録は受け付けません。読込み時にダウンロード・ビルド・検証計算・MPI初期化・ワーカー起動は行いません。記録はローカル検証の証拠で、電子署名や禁止ソルバー監査の代用ではありません。

既存の参照入力を使う `tools/test_isolated_worker.py EXECUTABLE EXISTING_REFERENCE NEW_VALIDATION` で、通常応答と直接復元を検証した記録を作成できます。これはRT計算を実行する開発用ツールです。新しいSCFは行いません。対応環境への配布が完了したという意味ではなく、手元の検証済み計算プログラムを明示して使います。

初期bundleには孤立系RT入力、`data_for_restart/info.bin`・`occupation.bin`・`wfn.bin`、相対パスで参照する擬ポテンシャル等を用意します。ローダーは不変の初期コピーを保持し、各状態が独立した作業コピーと子プロセスを持ちます。初期ローダーを閉じても既存状態は使えます。周期系GSの変換や孤立系GSの自動作成はしません。

## 同じ計算プロセス内での直接退避

`savepoint()` はFortran側の波動関数両バッファ、密度・ポテンシャル履歴、Poisson作業状態、双極子・外場履歴、エネルギー、更新番号を保持し、`IsolatedSavepoint` を返します。一つの状態につき一つだけ保持できます。`restore_savepoint(token)` は出力を元の長さへ戻して同じプロセスで復元し、時間発展を呼びません。トークンは復元後も残り、繰り返し復元できます。不要になったら `release_savepoint(token)` で明示的に解放します。解放だけなら現在の計算結果は変えません。

別状態のトークン・解放済みのトークン・再起動前のトークンは、復元前に拒否します。トークンはディスクへ保存する形式ではありません。退避を保持したまま履歴再生の `snapshot()/restore()` や `save_checkpoint()` は使えません。計算状態と退避の寿命は呼び出し元が管理し、状態を閉じれば退避も終了します。

`worker_statistics()` は明示的な問い合わせで、PID、実際の時間発展回数 `updates`、受理番号 `step`、直接復元回数 `direct_restores` を返します。通常の更新に全体通信を追加しません。復元だけでは `updates` は増えません。

直接退避中の失敗で、別ワーカーの起動や履歴再生は行いません。出力の巻き戻しに一時失敗した場合は `usable=False` として更新を止め、同じトークンで復元を完了できます。ワーカー喪失や復元結果を確定できない障害は使用不可として返します。`usable` を確認せずに更新を再開しません。任意のOS/MPI障害からの復帰を保証するものではありません。

退避の対象は現在検証している主要二出力です。未対応の空間出力を要求した場合は退避作成だけを拒否し、通常のE駆動計算は引き続き使えます。退避には電子状態一式を保持する分のメモリが必要です。

## 共通の場入力と観測

```python
from salmonpy.field_input import FieldPacket, FieldValue
frame = state.step_fields(FieldPacket(E=FieldValue(
    [0., 0., 1.e-5], time=state.time+state.dt,
    position=(0.,0.,0.), unit='E:au')))
```

この例は上記の生きている状態内で実行します。Eの時刻・位置・単位を照合し、未提供とゼロを区別します。A/Hは消費せず、AからEを暗黙に再構成しません。単独の `step(E)` は既存の定数区間Eを受ける積分順を維持します。

`frame.electron_number` はFortranが積分した実測電子数です。減少率1e-5は診断の目安であり、それだけで計算を停止しません。`frame.internal_energy` は既存の計算頻度で新しく評価された端点だけ値を返し、それ以外は `None` です。計算頻度を勝手に増やしたりゼロ外場ドリフトを自動で差し引いたりしません。

## プロセス終了後の直接ディスク再開

```python
with model.new_state(dt=dt) as state:
    for E in first_fields:
        state.step(E)
    state.save_direct_checkpoint('new-electronic-checkpoint')
# 元のワーカーは終了。同じGSと設定から新しい状態を作る。
with model.new_state(dt=dt) as resumed:
    resumed.restore_direct_checkpoint('new-electronic-checkpoint')
    assert resumed.worker_statistics()['updates'] == 0
    for E in remaining_fields:
        frame = resumed.step(E)
```

`salmonpy.isolated-direct/1`はFortranの数値配列・履歴・Poisson・XC作業状態、
受理ステップ、観測値、出力ファイルを保存します。各ファイルのSHA256と、
モデル・実行ファイルの一致を読み込み前に確認します。元のGSは別途指定し、
初期化時に読み込みます。SCFや経過済み時間ステップの再計算はしません。
別ワーカーで読み込みと出力再接続を完了してから切り替えるため、
候補の復元失敗時も元のワーカーを保持します。復元した状態の異常時に、
履歴再生へ暗黙に切り替えません。復元中は電子状態が追加で必要です。

実行ファイル・GS／入力・dt・最大ステップ数・位置・スレッド数は同一にします。
異なるコンパイラや配列配置をまたぐ可搬形式ではありません。
保存点を解放してからディスク操作を行います。max_bytesは任意の読み込み量制限で、
メモリ使用量の制限ではありません。既存ディレクトリは上書きしません。
対象は既存の確認済み出力モードです。ワーカー検証記録は実際のプロセス終了後の
再開を含むrevision5を要求し、古い記録は受け付けません。

応答サンプルで`--stop-after 7 --direct-checkpoint NEW_CHECKPOINT`を指定すると、
7ステップで終了して保存します。同じE NPZと設定で別途
`--resume-direct NEW_CHECKPOINT`を指定すると、残りだけを進めます。
これは分子単体の保存です。FDTD結合全体の再開には二つの場と結合時刻も
協調して保存する必要があります。

## 履歴の保存と再実行（直接復元とは別）

`snapshot()/restore()` は受理済みEと観測量の履歴を保存・再実行する入口です。同じ初期モデル、dt・位置・容量・スレッド数・バイナリが必要です。候補プロセスの観測量を照合してから交換し、復元失敗時は元の状態を保持します。費用は履歴長に依存し、検証中は新旧二ワーカー分の資源を使います。直接退避を使わない通常の `step()` の異常回復もこの履歴再実行方式です。

```python
state.save_checkpoint('new-history-checkpoint')
resumed.restore_checkpoint('new-history-checkpoint', max_bytes=16*1024*1024)
```

`resumed` は同じ初期データ・設定で呼び出し元が作成した状態です。ディスク形式は `salmonpy.isolated-tddft-checkpoint/3`。E0、初期／現在の9観測量、E履歴と観測履歴をハッシュ付きで保存するZarr v3互換形式です。GSは別途用意します。`max_bytes` は追加のファイル読み込み予算であり全RSS上限ではありません。これは波動関数の直接チェックポイントではありません。直接の数値保存には上記のsave_direct_checkpointを使います。

## 出力とFDTD

`python -m salmonpy.examples.isolated_response EXECUTABLE VALIDATION_JSON BUNDLE RT_INPUT E_NPZ NEW_OUTPUT` は、E[steps,3]とスカラーdtを原子単位で持つNPZから双極子アーカイブを作ります。`--checkpoint` は明示した履歴再実行用の保存です。応答・単位・ソースの出典を明示し、結果はソースツリー外へ保存します。

双方向FDTD結合は [分子とFDTD](DIPOLE_RADIATION.md) の `MolecularFeedback` と、完全例 `examples/molecular_feedback.py` を使います。取消に `savepoint/restore_savepoint/release_savepoint` を使い、電子履歴を再計算しません。真空自己場の差し引きは真空の放射反作用も除きます。

既存C2H2 GS・PZ、64場ステップの6ランク検証では、正常時は電子更新63回、1区間の取消・再試行時は64回で、各実行内のPIDは変わりません。復元による追加更新は0回、受理した全保存配列・六面記録は以前の結果と完全一致しました。これは短時間の接続検証で、光学物性の収束保証ではありません。

sections.heading: ISOLATED_TDDFT.en.md
sections.text:
# Isolated TDDFT: E input and named dipoles

Explicit process-isolated PZ, fixed ions, unpolarized scalar pseudopotentials and middlepoint propagation. Crystalline TDDFT/SBE remain A-driven. The response is a charge dipole, not a current density. Grid, dt and electronic-box convergence remain the user's responsibility.

## Calculation program and initial state

```python
from salmonpy.isolated_tddft import load_isolated_runtime, IsolatedTDDFTInitialState

runtime = load_isolated_runtime('salmon', 'validation/report.json')
with IsolatedTDDFTInitialState.from_salmon(
        'existing-bundle', 'rt.inp', runtime=runtime,
        max_steps=100, threads=1, timeout=60) as initial:
    with initial.new_state(dt=.02) as state:
        saved = state.savepoint()
        frame = state.step([0., 0., 1.e-5])
        print(frame.time, frame.dipole, frame.electron_number)
        state.restore_savepoint(saved)  # same worker, no evolution calls
        state.release_savepoint(saved)
```

E/time use atomic units and dipoles use e*bohr. `dipole` includes ions and electrons; `electronic_change` is the electronic dipole change. Arrays are read-only. Initial E/time are zero. `new_state(position=...)` declares the field evaluation position (default zero, bohr), without moving or rotating atoms.

Loading checks a bounded local validation record and the executable SHA256. Current schema: `salmonpy.isolated-worker-validation/5`. E3 still returns nine numerical values, but evidence of same-process direct restoration with zero extra evolution calls and stale-token rejection is required. Revision3 receipts are rejected. Loading never downloads, builds, runs validation, initializes MPI or starts a worker. A receipt is local evidence, not a signature or a substitute for eigensolver auditing.

`tools/test_isolated_worker.py EXECUTABLE EXISTING_REFERENCE NEW_VALIDATION` explicitly runs ordinary response and direct-restore validation, reusing the supplied GS without SCF. It is a development calculation tool. This does not announce a distributed runtime catalog: supply a locally validated calculation program.

The bundle needs an isolated RT input, `data_for_restart/info.bin`, `occupation.bin`, `wfn.bin` and relative pseudopotential assets. The loader owns an immutable initial copy; states own independent working copies/processes. Existing states survive closing their loader. No periodic-GS conversion or implicit isolated SCF is performed.

## Direct savepoint in the same worker

`savepoint()` retains both orbital buffers, density/potential histories, Poisson work state, dipole/field histories, energy and accepted index in Fortran and returns `IsolatedSavepoint`. One live token per state. `restore_savepoint(token)` restores the numerical state and output journal in the same process, without propagation. It keeps the token for repeated restoration. Explicitly call `release_savepoint(token)` when done; release alone preserves the current state.

Foreign, released or pre-restart tokens are rejected before restoration. Tokens are not a disk format. Release a live token before using replay `snapshot()/restore()` or `save_checkpoint()`. The caller owns these lifetimes; closing the state ends its savepoint too.

`worker_statistics()` explicitly queries PID, real evolution count `updates`, accepted index `step` and `direct_restores`. No application-wide communication is added to normal updates. Restore alone does not increment `updates`.

While a direct token is active, failures never start a replay worker. A temporary output-journal failure suspends updates (`usable=False`); explicitly finish restoration with the same token. Worker loss or an indeterminate restore is reported as unusable. Do not resume updates without checking usability. This is not arbitrary OS/MPI failure recovery.

Only the two audited principal output streams are currently supported. Unsupported spatial output modes reject savepoint creation only; ordinary E-driven calculations remain usable. The backup needs memory for an additional electronic state.

## Common field input and observations

```python
from salmonpy.field_input import FieldPacket, FieldValue
frame = state.step_fields(FieldPacket(E=FieldValue(
    [0., 0., 1.e-5], time=state.time+state.dt,
    position=(0.,0.,0.), unit='E:au')))
```

Run this inside a live state context. E time/position/units are checked; missing E differs from zero. A/H are not consumed and E is not implicitly reconstructed from A. Standalone `step(E)` retains the existing constant-interval E integrator order.

`frame.electron_number` is the actual Fortran density integral. Relative loss1e-5 is an advisory diagnostic, not an automatic stop. `frame.internal_energy` is present only at fresh endpoints according to the existing energy cadence, otherwise `None`. Never silently add energy evaluations or subtract zero-field drift.

## Direct disk restart after process exit

```python
with model.new_state(dt=dt) as state:
    for E in first_fields:
        state.step(E)
    state.save_direct_checkpoint('new-electronic-checkpoint')
# The original worker has now exited. Reopen the same GS model/settings.
with model.new_state(dt=dt) as resumed:
    resumed.restore_direct_checkpoint('new-electronic-checkpoint')
    assert resumed.worker_statistics()['updates'] == 0
    for E in remaining_fields:
        frame = resumed.step(E)
```

`salmonpy.isolated-direct/1` stores the Fortran numerical buffers/histories,
Poisson and XC work state, accepted index, cached observations and output streams.
Per-file SHA256, model settings and executable identity are checked before loading.
The original GS bundle is supplied separately; it is loaded for initialization,
with no SCF and no replay of elapsed electronic steps. A fresh candidate process
is installed only after complete import and output reconnection. Failed imports
leave the current worker unchanged. Imported states never silently recover by
replay. One additional electronic state may coexist during restoration.

Use the same executable, GS/input, dt, capacity, position and thread settings.
This binary format has no cross-compiler or changed-layout portability claim.
Release live savepoints before disk operations. `max_bytes` optionally limits
bytes read, not resident memory. Saved directories are never overwritten.
Only the existing audited output modes are supported. The current worker receipt
revision5 includes real process-exit restart proof; older receipts are rejected.

The response example accepts `--stop-after 7 --direct-checkpoint NEW_CHECKPOINT`.
A second invocation with the same E NPZ and settings can use
`--resume-direct NEW_CHECKPOINT`; it advances only the remaining samples.
These operations save the molecule only; a complete coupled-field restart must
also coordinate both FDTD states and the coupling clock.

## History persistence and replay (separate from direct restore)

`snapshot()/restore()` save and replay accepted E/observation history. They require the same initial model, dt, position, capacity, threads and binary. A candidate is checked before replacement, preserving the original if replay fails. Cost grows with history, with two workers coexisting during validation. Ordinary `step()` recovery without a live direct token also uses this history-replay mechanism.

```python
state.save_checkpoint('new-history-checkpoint')
resumed.restore_checkpoint('new-history-checkpoint', max_bytes=16*1024*1024)
```

The caller creates `resumed` with the same initial data/settings. `salmonpy.isolated-tddft-checkpoint/3` is a hashed Zarr v3-compatible history format containing E0, initial/current nine observations, E history and observation history. Supply the GS separately. `max_bytes` adds a file-reading budget, not an RSS limit. This is not a direct wavefunction checkpoint. Use the direct API above for numerical persistence after worker exit.

## Outputs and FDTD

`python -m salmonpy.examples.isolated_response EXECUTABLE VALIDATION_JSON BUNDLE RT_INPUT E_NPZ NEW_OUTPUT` writes a dipole archive from E[steps,3] and scalar dt in atomic units. `--checkpoint` explicitly saves replay history. Retain units/provenance and store results outside the source tree.

Use [Molecular/FDTD coupling](DIPOLE_RADIATION.en.md), `MolecularFeedback` and the complete `examples/molecular_feedback.py` for feedback. Cancellation uses `savepoint/restore_savepoint/release_savepoint` without electron-history recomputation. Own-vacuum subtraction also removes vacuum radiation reaction.

The short C2H2 PZ MPI6 test uses64 field intervals: normal execution needs63 electronic updates; one rejected interval and retry needs64. The PID stays constant within each run. Restore adds zero evolution calls and every accepted saved array/six-face record exactly matches the previous result. This is wiring validation, not converged optical accuracy.

sections.heading: CHECKPOINTING.md
sections.text:
# 保存／再開の対応可否と互換性

## 現行の混在計算の保存形式

直接保存は`salmonpy.native-direct/4`、履歴再実行型は`salmonpy.native-replay/2`に統一しました。旧スキーマの受入れ・変換とIDなし旧保存を救済するオプションは削除しました。自作呼び出し元の識別情報なし状態は現行形式で扱えますが、保存側と復元側で識別情報の有無を一致させる必要があります。

[English](CHECKPOINTING.en.md)

`salmonpy.checkpointing` は、内蔵・自作の計算コードに共通する保存／復元の検査と実行を提供します。
`execute_checkpoint` は全参加ランクの検査後に、明示的に渡したSAVE／LOAD関数を呼びます。
直列呼び出し元プログラムは`comm=None`、MPI呼び出し元プログラムは自分のコミュニケータを渡します。ソルバーの内部型や継承は不要です。
importや検査時にMPI初期化、ファイル操作、コンパイル、ダウンロード、時間発展、保存／復元のコールバックは行いません。

## 対応能力の宣言

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import CheckpointCapability

capability = CheckpointCapability(
    "my-material-json/1", ("save", "restore"), (1,),
    identity="implementation-and-fixed-model-input-digest",
)
record = capability.to_dict()
assert CheckpointCapability.from_dict(record) == capability
```

宣言は不変です。`format`は版付きの保存形式、`modes`はsave／restoreの一方または両方を含むtupleです。
`decomposition`は正の整数tupleで、積を実際の群サイズに合わせます。軸の順序も仕様の一部で、
`(2,1)`と`(1,2)`は異なります。実装・固定モデル入力・計算プログラムの識別には`identity`へ検証した識別子や
ハッシュを渡します。空のidentityは既存計算処理-direct/2との互換性のため記録から省略します。
検査対象は明示された宣言です。モデルの識別と保存ファイルの完全性は呼び出し元プログラム側で管理します。

## 計算処理独自の保存／復元を実行する

`CheckpointTarget`へ引数なしのコールバックを登録し、`execute_checkpoint`のoperationにsave／restoreを指定します。
パスと保存形式は計算処理が決めます。引数を渡す場合はクロージャーや`functools.partial`を使えます。
ファイル形式の完全な例は`python -m salmonpy.examples.custom_checkpoint NEW_OUTPUT`で実行できます。

同じ入口から、メモリ上の計算処理独自トークンも受け渡せます。

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import CheckpointCapability, CheckpointTarget, execute_checkpoint

groups = [{"name": "user", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": ["film"]}]
cap = CheckpointCapability("user-memory/1", ("save", "restore"), (1,), identity="model-v1")
state = {"value": 17}
saved_run = execute_checkpoint(
    None, groups, operation="save",
    states={"film": CheckpointTarget(cap, save=lambda: dict(state))})
payload = saved_run["states"]["film"]
candidate = {}
execute_checkpoint(
    None, groups, operation="restore", saved=saved_run["compatibility"],
    states={"film": CheckpointTarget(cap, restore=lambda: candidate.update(payload))})
assert candidate == state and candidate is not state
```

戻り値には`compatibility`のJSON、プロセス内の`field`の戻り値、文字列の点IDをキーにした`states`の戻り値が含まれます。
不透明なトークン、配列、保存情報はコピーやMPI転送を行わず、そのプロセス内に保持します。所有権は計算処理が管理します。
Noneを含む任意の戻り値を受け付け、失敗は例外で通知します。Falseを返すだけでは失敗扱いになりません。

対応能力とコールバックの存在を全ランクで検査してから処理を始めます。各群の点順を同期したスロットで進めるため、
群ごとの点数が違っても使えます。通常のコールバック例外は全ランクでRuntimeFailureとなり、後続スロットを停止します。
実行済みの状態変更は残ります。MPIを使う計算処理は、自分の群の通信手順を完了してから例外を返してください。
計算処理内で待ち続けるランクの解放や、Fortran STOP・プロセス異常からの回復は共通入口では行いません。
影響した候補を破棄するか、計算処理ジョブを中止するかは呼び出し元プログラムが判断します。MPI初期化・分割・終了も呼び出し元プログラムが管理します。
メタデータ・ファイルのハッシュ照合と完了情報の公開は呼び出し元プログラム／計算処理の方針に従い、計算処理例では既存の一覧とmarkerを維持します。

## 直列の自作の計算コード

同梱例は、自作モデル、JSON保存、SHA256検証、独立した状態、連続実行との比較を一通り実行します。

```sh
python -m salmonpy.examples.custom_checkpoint NEW_OUTPUT
```

17ステップで保存し、残り15ステップだけ進めて32ステップの連続実行と電流が完全一致します。
モデルを変更した場合は、ローダーを呼ぶ前に拒否します。漸化式は接続確認用の合成データであり、物質の物理予測ではありません。

この例のうち、対応可否・互換性の検査部分は次のように書けます。

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import check_checkpoint_compatibility
from salmonpy.examples.custom_checkpoint import UserCurrent

groups = [{"name": "user", "role": "material", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": ["film"]}]
state = UserCurrent()
saved = check_checkpoint_compatibility(
    None, groups, states={"film": state.checkpoint_capability}, operation="save")
# ホスト側で本体と返されたメタデータを保存し、ハッシュを検証する。
candidate = UserCurrent()
check_checkpoint_compatibility(
    None, groups, states={"film": candidate.checkpoint_capability},
    operation="restore", saved=saved,
    required_files=("state.json",), available_files=("state.json",))
# 検査成功後、ホスト側でcandidate.load(検証済みファイルのパス)を呼べる。
```

`available_files`はファイル名の一覧です。APIは安全な相対POSIXパスと必須ファイルの存在を一覧上で確認します。
ファイルの読込やハッシュ照合は行いません。呼び出し元プログラム側で保存内容を認証し、候補が未進行状態であることを確認してから
ローダーを実行入口へ登録します。上の断片はメタデータの検査例で、実際のI/Oとハッシュ検査は実行可能な同梱例に含まれます。

## MPI呼び出し元プログラムと失敗の共有

渡したコミュニケータの全ランクが、同じ順序でAPIを呼びます。`groups`は通常のmappingのlist／tupleで、
nameとranks、必要ならroleとpoint_idsを指定します。ランク番号は渡したコミュニケータ内の番号で、全ランクを
重複なく群へ割り当てます。物質群の点IDは整数または文字列で、文字列表現も含めて所有先を重複させません。
場の群はrole=field、点IDなしとします。物質単独利用には場の群を用意する必要はありません。

各ランクは自分の群の`states`と、場のランクでは`field`の宣言だけを渡します。宣言にはオブジェクトと明示的な
mappingのどちらも使えます。群サイズ、点の網羅、群内宣言、全体の所有ランクと保存時メタデータを照合します。
操作と保存情報は全ランクで一致させ、群内ランクの並びも変更しません。

ランクごとに未検査の設定がある場合は、mappingを渡すとAPI内でエラーを集合的に扱えます。
APIに入る前の宣言構築・読込で例外が出た場合は捕捉し、その文字列を`local_error`として渡して全ランクが検査へ入ります。
1ランクのエラーでも、全ランクがLOADへ進む前に拒否します。コミュニケータは有効なものを呼び出し元プログラムが用意し、
初期化・分割・終了を管理します。APIはrank／size／allgatherを使い、mpi4pyを自分でimportしません。

```python
from mpi4py import MPI
from salmonpy.checkpointing import check_checkpoint_compatibility

comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD  # ホストが初期化済み。この例は3ランク。
groups = [
    {"name": "field", "role": "field", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": []},
    {"name": "material", "ranks": [1, 2], "point_ids": ["film"]},
]
field = {"format": "user-field/1", "modes": ["save", "restore"], "decomposition": [1]}
material = {"format": "user-current/1", "modes": ["save", "restore"],
            "decomposition": [2, 1], "identity": "fixed-model-and-runtime-digest"}
saved = check_checkpoint_compatibility(
    comm, groups, operation="save", field=field if comm.rank == 0 else None,
    states={} if comm.rank == 0 else {"film": material})
```

復元時はoperation=restoreとし、全ランクで同じ保存メタデータを渡します。必須ファイルの一覧はランクごとに用意できます。
エラーは`salmonpy.errors.InputError`（ValueErrorの派生）で通知し、成功時は`salmonpy.direct-compatibility/1`のJSONを返します。

## 復元失敗時に元の状態を維持する

失敗時に元の状態を保つ復元には`restore_checkpoint`を使います。同時に切り替える必要があるローカルな可変状態を、
一つの`CheckpointState`へ保持します。呼出中は計算を停止し、成功後はこのホルダーから状態を参照してください。
`stage_restore()`は独立した候補へ読込・検証を行って返します。元の状態を書き換えたり、候補と可変の数値資源を
共有したりしないことが仕様です。元と同じオブジェクト、候補の使い回し、Noneの返却は拒否します。

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import (CheckpointCapability, CheckpointTarget,
                                   CheckpointState, restore_checkpoint)

groups = [{"name": "user", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": ["film"]}]
cap = CheckpointCapability("user-memory/1", ("save", "restore"), (1,), identity="model-v1")
from salmonpy.checkpointing import check_checkpoint_compatibility
saved = check_checkpoint_compatibility(None, groups, states={"film": cap})
original = {"step": 5}
live = CheckpointState(states={"film": original})
run = restore_checkpoint(
    None, groups, live=live, saved=saved,
    states={"film": CheckpointTarget(cap, stage_restore=lambda: {"step": 17})})
assert live.states["film"]["step"] == 17
assert run["previous"]["states"]["film"] is original
assert original == {"step": 5}
```

共通入口は全候補を準備し、MPIで失敗を共有し、成功の合意後に各ランクのローカル状態一式を一回の参照代入で切り替えます。
切替中に利用者のコードは呼びません。以前の状態は`run['previous']`へ保持するため、成功後の資源破棄は明示的に行います。
既存の外部変数は旧オブジェクトを指し続けます。バインディングを作り直すか、ホルダーを参照するクロージャーを使ってください。
準備中は元と候補が共存する分のメモリ・資源が必要です。

通常の準備失敗では`AtomicRestoreError`（RuntimeFailureの派生）が`original_preserved=True`を返し、
全ホルダーは元の状態一式を維持します。元の状態から計算を継続できます。任意の`discard_restore(candidate)`で、
準備を試みた候補を逆順の同期スロットで破棄できます。準備中の例外や危険な参照を検出した場合は、
該当する全ランクで`discard_restore(None)`も呼びます。部分的な準備資源とNoneを扱い、例外前に自群の通信手順を
完了してください。候補ファクトリー自身が失敗時の割当資源を片付けてから例外を返す方法も使えます。
破棄時のエラーは`error.cleanup_errors`へ分けて報告します。破棄処理でも元の状態を変更してはいけません。
計算処理の独立性仕様の下で、元のオブジェクトを破棄コールバックへ渡すことはありません。

`execute_checkpoint(..., operation='restore', atomic=True, live=live)`も同じ保護経路です。
従来のexecute_checkpointは互換性のため非原子的な実行を既定とします。通常のLOADだけを持つ対象は、保護経路では
LOADを呼ぶ前に拒否し、自動で従来方式へ切り替えません。
LD/SBEはnew_stateとsnapshot復元で候補を作れます。自作JSONファクトリーは実行可能なサンプルを参照してください。

### 計算処理数値候補（実験的）

明示的に再ビルドしたPythonから直接呼ぶFDTD・標準TDDFT・高速PR版HSEには、checkpoint_protocol=1の候補ABIがあります。
checkpointのmodeは0=保存、1=従来の即時復元、2=独立した数値候補の読込、3=準備済み候補の反映、4=破棄です。
候補は1 計算処理 lifetimeにつき1個です。元の計算を止め、全群で2を完了・合意してから3を呼びます。
失敗時は全群で4を呼び、元の状態から継続できます。HSE履歴も候補に保持し、3ではファイルを再読込しません。
古いライブラリには対応を推測せず、版確認で拒否します。

内部ヘルパー`salmonpy._native_checkpoint.NativeRestoreCandidate`と
`tools/test_native_restore_candidates_mpi.py`が共通APIとの接続を示します。
stage_restore／discard_restoreには候補のstage／discardを結び、共通APIで全候補の成功を確認した後、
各群でpublishを呼び、保存時のPython側A・電流・時計も準備済みデータで合わせます。
一般のホルダー切替だけでは計算処理反映は完了しません。この内部仕様は安定した公開C ABIではありません。

独立しているのは可変の数値候補です。MPI・Libxc・FFT等の初期化済み資源は既存のコンテキストに残り、
複数計算の同時実行を可能にするものではありません。反映後に旧参照で旧計算を継続することもできません。
反映は準備済みメモリを使いますが、一部の代入は割当を伴い、メモリ枯渇・プロセス異常は回復保証外です。
通常のmpi_mixed_nativeへの接続は次節を参照してください。互換なMPI分割・入力・ハッシュの検査も引き続き必要です。

保証は、参加MPIランクが正常で、正しい独立候補ファクトリーが扱える例外の範囲です。
プロセス異常、通信断、Fortran STOP、準備中に元を変更・共有する計算処理からの回復は対象外です。

## 既存の混在計算

混在サンプルも共通の検査・実行APIを使い、ソルバー固有の未進行状態・C/Fortranの呼び出し規約の確認を維持します。
既存計算処理-direct/2の互換情報、固定した計算処理ペイロード、数値の更新順は変えません。
自作のdirect-state/1サンプルアダプターは、`checkpoint_capability`へオブジェクト／mappingを公開できます。
従来のcheckpoint_format／checkpoint_modes／checkpoint_decompositionも使えます。
コールバック、時計、A・電流の仕様は[COUPLED.md](COUPLED.md)を参照してください。

現在は同じ分割と宣言された形式・識別子を照合します。保存内容の変換、MPI分割変更時の再配置、
汎用アーカイブのI/O、失敗時の原子的な巻き戻しは計算処理／呼び出し元プログラム側の担当です。
共通入口は渡された関数を実行しますが、保存実装の正しさや原子的復元を認証するものではありません。互換情報のない旧計算処理-direct/1は、元の対応版で扱います。

## 通常の混在サンプルの失敗時に元の状態を保つ復元

`mpi_mixed_native --direct-resume PATH`は失敗時に元の状態を保つ復元を既定にします。初期化済みの場・標準TDDFT・
高速PR HSEは候補対応計算プログラムが必要です。場の候補にはPMLと全LD材料のP/J・更新履歴も含まれます。
SBEは新しい独立ハンドルへsnapshotを復元します。Python側の時計・電流・A・応答アダプター・所有リストと
表示用のframes.jsonも反映前に準備し、全MPIランクの成功確認後に反映します。追加のSCFや時間発展は行いません。

同じセッションを停止した状態なら、内部の`examples._direct_checkpoint.checkpoint(..., restore=True)`は
進行済み状態にも使えます。準備失敗は全ランクへAtomicRestoreErrorとして返り、元の場・LD・電子状態・
時計・参照・failedフラグを維持します。全ランクで同じ判断を行い、そのまま計算を続けるか、原因を除いて
同じ保存データで再試行できます。入力・履歴の検査失敗もLOAD前に拒否します。

成功後はsession.statesから現在の物質状態を取得してください。古いSBEハンドルは閉じます。
旧ハンドルの解放エラーはcoupled.checkpoint_cleanup_errorsへ分けて報告し、成功した復元を失敗として扱いません。
初期化済み計算処理資源は引き続き単一lifetimeで、反映時のメモリ枯渇・プロセス異常・通信断は保証外です。

古いABI、プロセス分離版HSE、自作の即時LOADのみの対象は、保護経路で読込前に拒否します。
通常サンプルは保護付き復元だけを使います。共通APIの`protected=False`は、自作バックエンドを明示的に非原子操作で扱う場合の指定です。
この指定には途中失敗時の元状態保持の保証がありません。自動で切り替えません。

検査用の`tools/test_mixed_protected_restore_mpi.py`は通常サンプルの引数を受け取り、後の電子状態の候補読込後に
1ランクを意図的に失敗させます。場内2種類LD・SBE・内部MPI TDDFT／高速PR HSEの元状態保持、
元からの継続、再試行後の連続実行との一致を確認します。リポジトリ内で使うときだけ`--kernel LIB`で
明示的にビルド済みLD/SBEライブラリを選べます。wheel利用時は不要です。

進行済みセッションを巻き戻しても、既に書いたSALMONの計算出力ファイルは切り詰めません。保存済みframesと再開後の
step戻り値で時系列を管理してください。ファイル出力を分ける場合は、新しいMPIジョブ・出力先で再開します。

復元用の別状態の同時保持を含むメモリ助言は[MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md)を参照してください。通常混在サンプルの予算超過は警告のみで、失敗時に元の状態を保つ復元を拒否しません。

## 混在サンプルのIDと再開

`python -m salmonpy.examples.mpi_mixed_native` は `--run-id`、論理点ID、物質ID、物質定義・初期状態のSHA256、MPI所有ランク、LDの材料番号対応を保存します。`mixed-example` は試験用の既定ラベルです。実験ごとに明示した `--run-id` を使用してください。定義の識別には出力先や一時ディレクトリを含めません。

`identity.json`、通常実行の `result.json` と `point-response` アーカイブに同じ識別情報を引き継ぎます。直接保存の外側の形式は `salmonpy.native-direct/3`、再計算方式は `salmonpy.native-replay/2` です。数値状態の内部形式と更新順は変更しません。直接復元はIDとMPI分割を数値状態の読み込み前に照合し、保存時は全ランクでのID一致を検査します。

旧版向けの引数・再開形式・欠落項目の補完は提供しません。現在のAPIと保存形式を使用してください。混在計算サンプルは常に物質・初期状態の識別情報を保存します。

## 点ID付きのメモリsnapshot

`PointState.snapshot()` は内部計算処理のsnapshotを `salmonpy.point-snapshot/1` の不変な点情報で包みます。`state.restore(saved)` は実験・点・物質定義・初期状態のIDとパッケージ版を照合してから計算処理を呼びます。別の点や実験、裸の計算処理tokenは拒否されます。明示した同一run/point IDであっても、計算処理のモデル・時間刻み等の整合性検査は引き続き必要です。

これはプロセス内の巻き戻し用であり、分岐・複製やディスク保存、MPI全体のトランザクションではありません。snapshot未対応の自作の計算コードでは `SnapshotError` となります。計算処理の復元失敗時の保証はその実装に従います。点ID不一致の拒否では内部のrestoreを呼びません。裸の状態に対する従来のsnapshot APIは変わりません。

`python -m salmonpy.examples.point_ld /new/output/directory` は別の点への復元拒否と、同一点での復元後の電流一致も確認します。

## Pythonから直接呼ぶTDDFTの更新前エラー拒否（限定対応）

新しく準備・ビルドした標準embedded TDDFTには `sp_tddft_error_protocol() == 1` があり、以下を結合先の物質MPI群だけで照合します。10: 不正・非有限入力／古いA／入力ファイル不在、11: ランク間不一致、12: 状態未作成・使用済み初期化、13: ステップ上限、14: 未確定の復元用の別状態あり。これらは数値更新前に全ランク同じコードで返り、既存の最後に成功した計算状態を変更しません。初期化前の10/11は初期化から終了までの期間を消費せず、Pythonからも入力を修正して初期化を再試行できます。失敗時の作業ディレクトリは診断用に残ります。

Pythonは版付きの仕様と全ランク一致を確認できた拒否だけを `InputError` とします。旧ライブラリ・未知のコード・非有限な戻り値は `RuntimeFailure` のままで、状態保持を推定しません。MPI群の全員が同じ入口へ参加する必要があります。無効なポインタ、MPI・プロセス異常、確保失敗は対象外です。本項の更新前検査ではソルバー深部を扱いません（次節の限定した深部復帰を参照）。初期化に入った後は引き続き1プロセス1初期化から終了までの期間です。高速HSEとPythonから直接呼ぶFDTDのエラー仕様はこの変更では拡張していません。

この保証は個別TDDFT状態の更新前拒否です。結合ドライバで他の部品が既に進んだ場合、全体の巻き戻しを保証せず、従来どおりセッションを失敗扱いにします。通常計算中の一般的な原子性が完成したとは判断しないでください。

## TDDFT深部の数値異常と直接巻き戻し

新しく準備・ビルドした標準Pythonから直接呼ぶTDDFTは `sp_tddft_recovery_protocol() == 1` を持ち、各ステップの数値状態をメモリへ退避します。伝播後の波動関数（20）、密度（21）、Hartree場（22）、XCポテンシャル／エネルギー（23）、電流／全エネルギー（24）を検査し、保護経路の伝播器エラー（25）も返します。検査は物質MPI群全体で合意してから戻ります。エラー時は波動関数・密度・場・伝播履歴・XC状態・カウンタ・管理フラグを最後に成功した計算状態へ直接戻し、伝播の再実行をしません。失敗したステップの通常RT出力も追加しません。

Pythonの `NativeTDDFTBackend` が返す状態の `advance(A_old,A_new)` は、版付き仕様と全ランク一致を確認できた復帰だけを `NumericalError` で通知します。`A` と `steps` はそのままで、原因を修正して同じ受理時刻から再試行できます。不正な波形を自動的に弱めたり、固定dtを変更したりしません。旧ライブラリや未知のエラーは `RuntimeFailure` の保守的な扱いを維持し、復帰を推定しません。

対象は周期・非スピン分極・固定イオン・中点伝播のPZ、TB-mBJ（自動／固定係数）、Libxc-PZ/PBEです。SOC、+U、jellium、イオン運動／力出力、Gram–Schmidt、projection/unfold、microscopic Maxwell結合などの保護対象外設定は更新前に15を返します。標準バッチ計算は従来の演算経路を使います。既存の外部checkpoint形式も変更しません。メモリ退避・有限性検査の費用が毎ステップ増えるため、資源見積もりには余裕を残してください。予算は警告のみです。

これはTDDFT群の状態保証です。FDTD・他の物質がすでに進んだ混在ステップ全体を自動巻き戻しする仕様ではありません。MPI／プロセス停止、確保失敗、未制御の外部ライブラリSTOP、初期化深部のSTOPや出力装置障害は未対応です。試験専用の一部ランク障害注入は `SALMONPY_RECOVERY_TESTING` を明示して別ビルドした場合のみで、本番ビルドには注入用C入口がありません。

## 高速PR版HSEの深部数値異常からの復帰

新しい `NativeFastHSEBackend` 用ライブラリは `sp_fast_hse_recovery_protocol() == 1` を宣言します。対応範囲は周期・非スピン分極・固定イオンの高速PR版HSE06、Taylor4／学習PT-CN、物質群内k点分割のMPI1／2です。通常版HSEへの切替はしません。

各ステップ前に電子状態とACE・因子／PT-CN履歴・交換キャッシュ・カウンタを退避します。FFTプランやMPIコミュニケータなどの所有資源はコピーしません。波動関数・密度・Hartree・XC・端点の有限性検査に加え、対応したACE演算エラー、PT-CNの収束／Gram／射影検査、履歴更新エラーを物質群全体で合意して返します。最後に成功した計算状態を直接戻し、過去ステップや交換履歴を再計算しません。失敗試行の通常RT出力を追加せず、A・時計・電流・エネルギーを維持します。診断ログは残ることがあります。

Pythonは宣言された版と全ランクの既知エラーを確認できる場合だけ `NumericalError` を返し、同じ受理時刻から修正した入力で再試行できます。旧ライブラリ・未知エラーは `RuntimeFailure` の保守的扱いを維持します。dtや入力振幅を自動変更しません。退避と検査のメモリ・時間費用は増え、予算超過は警告のみです。

これはHSE物質群の保証で、FDTDや他の物質を含む混在ステップ全体の自動巻戻しではありません。初期化深部、確保失敗、プロセス／MPI停止、未制御の外部STOP、出力装置障害は対象外です。異常を捕捉できない場合に継続を推定しないでください。

検証用 `tools/test_fast_hse_deep_recovery_mpi.py BUILD GS NEW_OUTPUT --steps 32 --fault-step 13` は2ランク、OMP／BLAS1、外側のtimeoutで実行します。`--split` は4ランクの独立2群です。`--overflow-A 1e100` はPT-CNの実数値発散試験用で、科学計算の入力ではありません。`--faults` は `SALMONPY_RECOVERY_TESTING` を明示した別ビルドだけに使い、本番には注入用入口を含めません。検証記録は `docs/fast-hse-deep-recovery-validation-2026-11-17.md` です。合成小規模系の実装検証であり、物理精度の収束保証ではありません。

## Pythonから直接呼ぶFDTDの数値異常復帰

新しい標準呼び出し元プログラムが管理するMPIライブラリは `sp_eh_recovery_protocol() == 1` を宣言します。`NativeEHField.advance` は対応する検査付き入口を選び、場・PML・場内の全LD・電流格子・時計をメモリ退避します。E更新後（20）、LD更新後（21）、H更新後（22）、点サンプル／積算A／通常観測出力の演算（23）の異常を場MPI群で合意し、退避した状態へ直接戻します。波の再伝播はしません。既知の復帰では `NumericalError` を返し、PythonのA・E・時計・failedも維持するため、入力を修正して再試行できます。失敗試行の通常観測ファイルは追加しませんが、診断・進行表示は残る場合があります。

対象は現在のFDTDのE/H更新平面波経路と場内LDです。線形応答専用経路、ASE／ART、周波数別観測は更新前に拒否します。バッチFDTDは従来経路を維持します。新しい入口を持たない旧バイナリ・未知エラーでは復帰を推定せず、従来の失敗扱いです。初期化・確保・MPI／プロセス停止・外部STOP・出力装置障害は保証外です。場群単体の保証であり、`CoupledStepper`／`ResponseSession`全体を自動巻戻し・自動再試行する機能ではありません。退避と検査の費用を見込み、メモリ予算は引き続き警告に使います。

`tools/test_eh_deep_recovery_mpi.py BUILD NEW_OUTPUT` を1／2ランク、OMP／BLAS1、外側timeoutで実行します。`--split` は4ランクの独立2群です。`--faults` は明示した別の `SALMONPY_RECOVERY_TESTING` ビルドだけに使います。本番には注入入口を含めません。数値オーバーフローの試験値は科学入力ではありません。

ステップ失敗時の計算処理数値／通常出力の巻戻しは [NATIVE_STEPPING.md](NATIVE_STEPPING.md) を参照。checkpointのLOADをステップ退避の代用にせず、両者の同時利用は拒否します。反映でownerが変わったらstep targetを作り直します。

## SCFメモリ保存を共通APIから使う

計算済みの生存中の `NativeGSState` は `checkpoint_capability` と
`checkpoint_target(snapshot=None)` を公開します。内部MPI群の全ランクが同順序で
呼びます。接続時に計算プログラムのプロトコルと生存SCFのメタデータを確認しますが、保存や数値反復は行いません。
形式は `salmonpy.native-scf-memory/1` です。識別子は物質・モデル・計算プログラムと
生存計算処理所有者のトークンに結び付き、同じ物質入力の別状態とも区別します。
MPI分割は実際の `(k, orbital, x, y, z)` です。

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import execute_checkpoint
comm = state.session.comm
plan = [{"name": "scf", "ranks": list(range(comm.size)), "point_ids": ["film"]}]
saved_run = execute_checkpoint(comm, plan, states={"film": state.checkpoint_target()})
with saved_run["states"]["film"] as payload:
    state.continue_scf(steps=5)
    execute_checkpoint(comm, plan, operation="restore", saved=saved_run["compatibility"],
                       states={"film": state.checkpoint_target(payload)})
    state.continue_scf(steps=5)
```

通信するのは互換性メタデータだけです。`NativeSCFSnapshot` は各ランクのFortran
メモリに残り、明示的に終了します。JSONだけでは復元できず、ディスク保存／プロセス
再開でもありません。通常PZ／Libxc-PZ/PBEと全k点CPU高速PR版HSE06の対応範囲・
数値実装は従来どおりです。

`execute_checkpoint(operation="restore")` は引き続き**直接復元**です。
SCF candidate protocol1を持たない旧計算プログラムでは `stage_restore` がないため、
`restore_checkpoint` は数値コールバック前に拒否します。対応計算プログラムでは次節の
独立した数値候補による準備を使えます。`execute_checkpoint` では後の部品が実行途中で失敗すると、先の部品だけ
復元済みになり得ます。全状態のロールバックを保証するものではありません。
異なる所有者・終了済みトークン・互換性不一致は数値コールバック前に拒否します。
候補作成の代わりに破壊的な復元へ落とさないでください。
`python -m salmonpy.examples.scf_resume BUILD_JSON NEW_OUTPUT` は共通入口を使います。
高速PR版HSE用ビルドでは `--xc hse06` を付けます。

### SCF候補の保護付き準備とFortran/Cで保持する計算状態への反映

`sp_gs_scf_candidate_protocol()==1` の対応計算プログラムでは、
`state.checkpoint_target(payload)` が独立した**数値候補**を作れます。
別の計算可能なGSソルバーを作る方式ではなく、FFT・XC・MPI資源は元の生存状態に
保持します。Fortranでスナップショットを切り離した領域へコピーし、SCF初期化・軌道
計算・交換演算を行いません。候補がある間は元の状態を予約し、メタデータの参照は
できますが、継続・直接復元・保存・終了は反映または破棄まで拒否します。
呼び出しは同じ内部MPI群の全ランクがメインスレッドで同順序に行います。
メモリ内・同じ生存状態・対応XC／MPI分割の制約は変わりません。

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import CheckpointState, restore_checkpoint
holder = CheckpointState(states={"film": state})
prepared = restore_checkpoint(
    comm, plan, live=holder, saved=saved_run["compatibility"],
    states={"film": state.checkpoint_target(payload)})
# 全参加者の準備が成功。この時点まで元の計算処理数値状態は変わりません。
for candidate in prepared["states"].values():
    candidate.publish()  # 内部MPI群のcollective。戻り値は元のstate。
state.continue_scf(steps=5)
```

holderに入るのは準備済み候補で、独立に計算を走らせる状態ではありません。
全計算処理候補を群内の同じ順序で反映してから計算を再開してください。
準備途中で処理可能な例外が出ると、途中の候補も含めて破棄して予約を解除し、
元の数値状態を保持します。元の軌道を継続でき、新しいtargetで復元を再試行できます。
手動準備を中止する場合は全体の準備成功確認前に `candidate.discard()` を呼びます。
一部反映後のエラーを無視して計算を続けないでください。計算処理反映では配列代入による
メモリ確保があり得るため、致命的な確保失敗・プロセス／通信故障・反映途中の任意の
異常を元に戻す保証ではありません。反映／破棄にファイル操作や時間発展はありません。
元スナップショットは準備・反映が終わるまで保持し、その後明示的に終了します。

`python -m salmonpy.examples.scf_resume BUILD_JSON NEW_OUTPUT --protected` で試せます。
全k点の高速PR版HSEビルドなら `--xc hse06` も付けます。
旧計算プログラムでは直接復元を維持し、未対応の失敗時に元の状態を保つ復元を直接復元へ落としません。

計算処理 SCFの同一ビルド・入力・MPI分割ディスク形式は、
`state.checkpoint_target(directory=...)` でこの共通APIに接続できます。
`scf_disk_capability` はファイルを読まない宣言で、stageがSHA256と入力を検査します。
全候補の準備後に各candidate.publish()を実行してください。失敗後の再試行には新しい
targetを作ります。詳細と2状態の例は [NATIVE_GS.md](NATIVE_GS.md) を参照してください。

計算処理 SCFの準備済み候補はclose／with文で明示的に破棄できます。GS状態のcloseは
その状態のPython所有候補を、snapshotのcloseはそのsnapshot由来の候補を先に破棄します。
C ABIで直接準備した外部所有候補は自動破棄しません。すべて同じMPI呼出し順が必要です。

# Checkpoint capability and compatibility

## Current mixed-session checkpoint formats

Direct persistence uses `salmonpy.native-direct/4`; replay persistence uses `salmonpy.native-replay/2`. Older schemas, automatic conversion and the unidentified-old-checkpoint option are removed. Custom hosts may use unidentified states in the current format, but identity presence must match between writer and reader.

[日本語](CHECKPOINTING.md)

`salmonpy.checkpointing` provides common input checking and execution for built-in and user
calculation implementations. `execute_checkpoint` calls explicitly bound SAVE/LOAD functions after input checking. It returns detached JSON
metadata after checking all participating ranks. Serial hosts pass `comm=None`;
MPI hosts supply their existing communicator. No solver context or inheritance
is required. Import and checking perform no MPI initialization, file access,
compilation, download, propagation or persistence callbacks.

## Declare capability

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import CheckpointCapability

capability = CheckpointCapability(
    "my-material-json/1", ("save", "restore"), (1,),
    identity="implementation-and-fixed-model-input-digest",
)
record = capability.to_dict()
assert CheckpointCapability.from_dict(record) == capability
```

The object is immutable. `format` identifies a versioned payload format;
`modes` is a tuple containing save and/or restore. `decomposition` is a positive
integer tuple whose product equals the actual group size. Its axis order is part
of the contract: `(2,1)` differs from `(1,2)`. Pin implementation, fixed model/input
and runtime identity with `identity`. An empty identity is omitted from metadata
for compatibility with existing solver-direct/2 archives. Checks compare the
explicit declarations; model identity and file integrity remain caller-owned.

## Execute calculation implementation-owned persistence

Bind zero-argument callbacks with `CheckpointTarget`, then call `execute_checkpoint`
with operation=save or restore. Paths and payload formats belong to the calculation implementation;
use closures or `functools.partial` to supply arguments. A complete file-based
example runs with `python -m salmonpy.examples.custom_checkpoint NEW_OUTPUT`.

The same entry can also transport an in-memory calculation implementation token:

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import CheckpointCapability, CheckpointTarget, execute_checkpoint

groups = [{"name": "user", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": ["film"]}]
cap = CheckpointCapability("user-memory/1", ("save", "restore"), (1,), identity="model-v1")
state = {"value": 17}
saved_run = execute_checkpoint(
    None, groups, operation="save",
    states={"film": CheckpointTarget(cap, save=lambda: dict(state))})
payload = saved_run["states"]["film"]
candidate = {}
execute_checkpoint(
    None, groups, operation="restore", saved=saved_run["compatibility"],
    states={"film": CheckpointTarget(cap, restore=lambda: candidate.update(payload))})
assert candidate == state and candidate is not state
```

The result contains `compatibility` JSON, a process-local `field` callback result
and a `states` mapping keyed by string point IDs. Opaque tokens, arrays and validation records
remain local; they are not copied or sent through MPI. The calculation implementation controls their
ownership. Callback return values, including None, are accepted; callbacks must
raise exceptions to report failure. A return value of False is not an error signal.

Capability and callback availability are checked collectively before the first
callback. Groups execute their own point order in synchronized slots, so groups
with different point counts are supported. An ordinary callback exception becomes
RuntimeFailure on every rank; later slots stop. Completed state changes remain.
A collective calculation implementation must complete its own MPI protocol before raising; the common
entry cannot unblock ranks stranded inside a calculation implementation collective or recover a
Fortran STOP/process crash. Hosts decide whether to discard affected candidates
or abort their solver job. MPI initialization, splitting and finalization stay
with the calling program. Metadata/hash authentication and completion publication also remain
calling program/calculation implementation policies; the solver sample preserves its existing inventory/marker.

## Serial user calculation implementation

The packaged example contains a complete user model, JSON persistence, payload
SHA256 verification, independent states and comparison with continuous execution:

```sh
python -m salmonpy.examples.custom_checkpoint NEW_OUTPUT
```

It saves at17 and advances only15 more steps through32; current is exactly equal
to continuous execution. Changing the model is rejected before its loader runs.
The recurrence is synthetic interface data, not a physical material prediction.

This is the input checking part of that workflow:

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import check_checkpoint_compatibility
from salmonpy.examples.custom_checkpoint import UserCurrent

groups = [{"name": "user", "role": "material", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": ["film"]}]
state = UserCurrent()
saved = check_checkpoint_compatibility(
    None, groups, states={"film": state.checkpoint_capability}, operation="save")
# The host now saves its payload and the returned metadata, and verifies hashes.
candidate = UserCurrent()
check_checkpoint_compatibility(
    None, groups, states={"film": candidate.checkpoint_capability},
    operation="restore", saved=saved,
    required_files=("state.json",), available_files=("state.json",))
# After successful admission, the host can call candidate.load(its_verified_path).
```

`available_files` is a names-only inventory. The API checks safe relative POSIX
paths and required-file presence; it does not read files or verify their hashes.
The calling program must authenticate payloads and check that the separate state prepared for restoration is fresh
before binding its own loader to the execution entry. The sample above illustrates metadata input checking;
the runnable example supplies the actual I/O and checksum checks.

## MPI hosts and failure agreement

All ranks of the supplied communicator call the API in the same sequence.
`groups` is a list/tuple of ordinary mappings containing name, ranks and optional
role/point_ids. Ranks are relative to this communicator; every rank belongs to
exactly one group. Material groups own distinct integer or string point IDs
(including distinct string representations). Field groups use role=field and no
point IDs. Standalone material groups need no field group.

Each rank supplies only its own group's `states` mapping and, on field ranks,
its field capability via `field`. Capabilities can be objects or explicit mapping
records. Group size, point coverage, within-group declarations, complete rank
ownership and the saved compatibility record are checked together. All ranks
must agree on operation and saved metadata, including unchanged group rank order.

Use plain declaration mappings for per-rank unvalidated configuration so errors
are collected inside the call. If constructing/inspecting a capability fails
before the call, catch the exception and pass its text as `local_error` while
still entering the collective. An error on one rank then prevents every rank
from proceeding to LOAD. The caller must supply a live communicator; it retains
ownership of initialization, splitting and finalization. The API accepts its
rank/size/allgather interface and imports no mpi4py itself.

```python
from mpi4py import MPI
from salmonpy.checkpointing import check_checkpoint_compatibility

comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD  # Example requires three ranks, already initialized by host.
groups = [
    {"name": "field", "role": "field", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": []},
    {"name": "material", "ranks": [1, 2], "point_ids": ["film"]},
]
field = {"format": "user-field/1", "modes": ["save", "restore"], "decomposition": [1]}
material = {"format": "user-current/1", "modes": ["save", "restore"],
            "decomposition": [2, 1], "identity": "fixed-model-and-runtime-digest"}
saved = check_checkpoint_compatibility(
    comm, groups, operation="save", field=field if comm.rank == 0 else None,
    states={} if comm.rank == 0 else {"film": material})
```

For restore, pass operation=restore and the same saved metadata on all ranks.
Required-file inventories may be rank-local. Errors use `salmonpy.errors.InputError`
(a ValueError), and successful calls return `salmonpy.direct-compatibility/1` JSON.

## Preserve live state on restore failure

Use `restore_checkpoint` for protected restoration. Keep every mutable local
component that must switch together in one `CheckpointState` holder. Pause
computation during the call, and access the states through the holder afterward.
`stage_restore()` loads and validates a fully independent candidate; it must never
mutate original states or share mutable numerical resources with them. Returning
the original object, a reused candidate or None is rejected.

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import (CheckpointCapability, CheckpointTarget,
                                   CheckpointState, restore_checkpoint)

groups = [{"name": "user", "ranks": [0], "point_ids": ["film"]}]
cap = CheckpointCapability("user-memory/1", ("save", "restore"), (1,), identity="model-v1")
from salmonpy.checkpointing import check_checkpoint_compatibility
saved = check_checkpoint_compatibility(None, groups, states={"film": cap})
original = {"step": 5}
live = CheckpointState(states={"film": original})
run = restore_checkpoint(
    None, groups, live=live, saved=saved,
    states={"film": CheckpointTarget(cap, stage_restore=lambda: {"step": 17})})
assert live.states["film"]["step"] == 17
assert run["previous"]["states"]["film"] is original
assert original == {"step": 5}
```

The common entry stages all components, shares errors across MPI, then votes before
publishing each rank's entire local bundle with one pointer assignment. Publication
calls no user code. Previous states remain strongly referenced in `run['previous']`;
retire their resources explicitly after success. Existing external aliases continue
to refer to old objects, so recreate bindings or use closures reading the holder.
The operation uses additional memory/resources while old and candidate states coexist.

On an ordinary staging failure, `AtomicRestoreError` (a RuntimeFailure) reports
`original_preserved=True`. All holders retain the original bundle, and computation
can continue from the originals. Optional `discard_restore(candidate)` cleans
attempted candidates in reverse synchronized slots. It is called on every relevant
rank, including `discard_restore(None)` when staging threw or returned an unsafe
alias. It must handle partial staging resources and complete its subgroup protocol
before raising. A stage factory can instead clean its own failed allocations before
raising. Cleanup errors are reported in `error.cleanup_errors`, separately from
preservation of the live states. discarding the prepared restore state never authorizes changing live
objects. Under the calculation implementation isolation contract, no original is passed to discard.

`execute_checkpoint(..., operation='restore', atomic=True, live=live)` is the same
protected path. Existing execute_checkpoint defaults to non-atomic execution for
compatibility; direct-only targets are rejected by the protected path with zero
LOAD calls, without fallback. LD/SBE states can be staged via new_state plus
snapshot restore; custom JSON factories are shown in the runnable example.

### solver numerical candidates (experimental)

Explicitly rebuilt FDTD called directly from Python, standard TDDFT and fast-PR HSE expose
checkpoint_protocol=1: modes0 save,1 legacy immediate restore,2 stage a detached
numerical candidate,3 publish prepared memory,4 discard. One candidate per solver
lifetime is allowed. Pause evolution, finish mode2 and agree success across every
calling program group before mode3. On handled failure every group discards with mode4 and
can continue its original. HSE retains validated exchange/history data in memory;
mode3 never reopens the checkpoint. Reject older libraries via the protocol query.

The internal `salmonpy._native_checkpoint.NativeRestoreCandidate` helper and
`tools/test_native_restore_candidates_mpi.py` demonstrate the common entry:
bind stage/discard callbacks, use the common API for collective preparation,
then call publish in each group and install preprepared Python A/current/clocks.
The generic holder switch alone does not finish solver publication. This is an
internal experimental contract, not a stable public C ABI.

Only mutable numerical candidates are detached. Initialized MPI/Libxc/FFT resources
remain in the existing context; this does not enable concurrent solver lifetimes
or continued use of an old alias after publication. Publication uses prepared
memory but includes allocating assignments: allocation failure/process death is
outside the recoverable contract. The ordinary mpi_mixed_native integration is described below.
Exact-layout/input/hash input checking is still required.

This contract covers handled exceptions with healthy participating MPI ranks and
correct isolated factories. It does not recover process crashes, communicator loss,
Fortran STOP or a calculation implementation which mutates/shares its original state during staging.

## Existing mixed solver calculations

The solver mixed sample uses both common input checking and execution, retaining solver-specific
fresh-state and solver-ABI checks. Existing solver-direct/2 compatibility metadata
is unchanged; pinned solver payloads and numerical update order are unchanged.
Custom direct-state/1 sample adapters may expose `checkpoint_capability` as an
object/mapping. The previous checkpoint_format/checkpoint_modes/
checkpoint_decomposition attributes remain accepted. The sample's callback/clock/
A/current requirements are described in [COUPLED.en.md](COUPLED.en.md).

Current input checking requires the same topology and declared format/identity. Payload
conversion, changed-topology redistribution, generic archive I/O and atomic rollback
remain calculation implementation/calling program responsibilities. The execution entry runs supplied functions without certifying the calculation implementation's
persistence implementation or atomic rollback. Historical solver-direct/1 archives
without compatibility metadata require their original matching reader.

## Protected restore in the ordinary mixed sample

`mpi_mixed_native --direct-resume PATH` now defaults to protected restore.
Initialized field/standard TDDFT/fast-PR HSE require candidate-capable runtimes.
The field candidate includes PML and every LD material's P/J/update history.
SBE loads snapshots into independent new handles. Python clocks, currents, A,
response adapters, ownership lists and frames.json are prepared before publication.
All MPI participants must succeed before anything live is published. No extra SCF
or time propagation is performed by restore.

The internal `examples._direct_checkpoint.checkpoint(..., restore=True)` also
accepts advanced paused sessions. A staging failure raises AtomicRestoreError on
all ranks and preserves original field/LD/electronic states, clocks, references
and failed flags. Make the same collective decision everywhere: continue the old
trajectory or remove the failure cause and retry the same checkpoint. Input/history
input checking errors are rejected before LOAD as well.

After success retrieve current states through session.states; old SBE handles are
retired. Release errors are separate coupled.checkpoint_cleanup_errors diagnostics,
not a failed restoration. solver resources still have one lifetime; allocation
failure during publication, process death and failed MPI remain outside recovery.

Older ABIs, process-isolated HSE workers and custom direct-only LOAD targets are
rejected before loading. The ordinary example always uses protected restoration. The common API still
allows explicit `protected=False` for custom non-atomic backend operations;
that mode does not preserve original states on mid-load failure. There is no automatic fallback.

`tools/test_mixed_protected_restore_mpi.py` takes the ordinary sample arguments,
injects a rank failure after loading a later electronic candidate, then checks
original preservation (including two field-local LD materials), continued old
evolution and exact retry results for SBE plus internal-MPI TDDFT/fast-PR HSE.
Source-tree tests can explicitly select a built LD/SBE library with `--kernel LIB`;
installed-wheel users do not need that override.

Live rewind does not truncate solver output files already written. Manage the
trajectory with the saved frames plus subsequent step returns, or resume in a
fresh MPI job/output directory to keep solver output streams separate.

Memory advice includes concurrent candidate storage; see [MEMORY.en.md](MEMORY.en.md). Exceeding the ordinary sample budget only warns and does not refuse protected restore.

## Mixed sample identity and restart

`python -m salmonpy.examples.mpi_mixed_native` preserves `--run-id`, logical point IDs, material IDs, material-definition and initial-state SHA256 digests, MPI ownership, and the LD cell-material mapping. The default `mixed-example` is a fixture label; provide an explicit run ID for each experiment. Output and temporary directories are excluded from definition fingerprints.

The same identity appears in `identity.json`, normal-run `result.json`, and the `point-response` archive. Identified direct checkpoints use `salmonpy.native-direct/3`; replay checkpoints use `salmonpy.native-replay/2`. Numerical payload formats and update order are unchanged. Direct restore checks identity and MPI ownership before loading numerical state; save checks agreement across all ranks.

Old arguments, checkpoint schemas and missing-field defaults are not supported. Use the current API and checkpoint writer. The mixed example always records material and initial-state identities.

## In-memory snapshots with point identity

`PointState.snapshot()` wraps the calculation implementation-owned snapshot with immutable `salmonpy.point-snapshot/1` identity. `state.restore(saved)` checks run, point, material-definition and initial-state identity plus package version before calling the calculation implementation. Cross-point/run and raw calculation implementation tokens are rejected. Even with explicit matching run/point IDs, the calculation implementation must still validate its model, time step and other settings.

This is process-local rewind, not branching, cloning, disk persistence or an MPI-wide transaction. Unsupported user-written calculation implementations raise `SnapshotError`. calculation implementation restore-failure guarantees remain the calculation implementation's responsibility; identity rejection invokes no calculation implementation restore callback. Raw-state snapshot APIs are unchanged.

`python -m salmonpy.examples.point_ld /new/output/directory` also verifies cross-point rejection and exact current continuation after same-point restore.

## TDDFT called directly from Python rejection before update (limited scope)

Newly prepared and built standard TDDFT called in the Python process exposes `sp_tddft_error_protocol() == 1`. Validation is collective on the attached material communicator:10 invalid/nonfinite input, stale A or missing input file;11 rank disagreement;12 unavailable lifecycle or repeated initialization;13 exhausted step capacity;14 pending separate state prepared for restoration. These codes return unanimously before numerical mutation. Initial input checking codes10/11 do not consume the lifetime; Python initialization can be retried with corrected input. Failed work directories remain for diagnosis.

Python maps only protocol-declared unanimous rejection to `InputError`. Old libraries, unknown codes or nonfinite results retain `RuntimeFailure`, with no inferred state guarantee. Every solver-group member must enter the same call. Invalid pointers, MPI/process failure, allocation errors, deep solver STOP and failures after numerical updates are outside this input checking-only contract; see the limited deep-recovery contract below. Actual initialization still consumes the one-process lifetime. Fast HSE and FDTD called directly from Python error contracts are unchanged.

This guarantee concerns an individual TDDFT state's pre-update rejection. A coupled session may already have advanced another component; it remains failed under the existing driver policy. This does not implement general coupled-step rollback.

## Direct rollback after deep TDDFT numerical errors

New standard TDDFT called directly from Python exposes `sp_tddft_recovery_protocol() == 1` and retains a per-step numerical payload in memory. Collective checks cover propagated wavefunctions(20), density(21), Hartree field(22), XC potential/energy(23), current/total energy(24), and a protected propagator error(25). Every material-group rank agrees before returning. Errors restore accepted orbitals, densities, fields, propagation history, XC state, counters and original overlap flags without propagation replay. Failed attempts add no ordinary RT output records.

A state returned by Python `NativeTDDFTBackend` raises `NumericalError` from `advance(A_old,A_new)` only for protocol-declared unanimous recovery. Its `A` and `steps` remain accepted; correct the cause and retry from that time. No automatic pulse weakening or dt changes are applied. Old libraries and unknown errors retain conservative `RuntimeFailure` handling without inferred recovery.

Supported: periodic, unpolarized, fixed-ion middlepoint PZ, automatic/fixed TB-mBJ, Libxc-PZ/PBE. SOC,+U,jellium, ionic motion/force output, Gram–Schmidt, projection/unfold and microscopic Maxwell coupling are outside the protected configuration and return15 before updating. Ordinary batch calculations retain their existing route; external checkpoint encoding is unchanged. Per-step copies/checks add memory and runtime overhead: leave resource headroom. Budgets remain warning-only.

This is a TDDFT-group guarantee, not automatic rollback of an entire mixed FDTD step whose other components may have advanced. MPI/process death, allocation failures, uncontrolled third-party STOP, deep initialization STOP and output-device failures are excluded. One-rank fault injection exists only in a separately compiled `SALMONPY_RECOVERY_TESTING` build; production builds export no injection entry.

## Deep numerical recovery for fast-PR HSE

New libraries for `NativeFastHSEBackend` declare `sp_fast_hse_recovery_protocol() == 1`. The guarded configuration is periodic, unpolarized, fixed-ion fast-PR HSE06 with Taylor4 / learned PT-CN and internal k-only MPI1/2. Conventional HSE is not a fallback.

Each step backs up electronic arrays and ACE, factor/PT-CN histories, exchange caches and counters. FFT plans, MPI communicators and other owning resources are not copied. Collective checks cover finite orbitals, density, Hartree, XC and endpoints, plus handled ACE operator errors, PT-CN convergence/Gram/retraction checks and history updates. Handled failures directly restore accepted numerical state without replaying propagation or exchange history. A, clocks, current and energy remain unchanged; failed attempts append no ordinary RT records. Diagnostic logs may remain.

Only a declared protocol and unanimous known error permit Python to raise `NumericalError` and retry with corrected input at the same accepted time. Old libraries and unknown errors retain conservative `RuntimeFailure` behavior. Neither dt nor drive amplitude changes automatically. Per-step backups/checks add memory and runtime cost; budgets remain advisory.

The guarantee covers the HSE material group, not automatic rollback of an entire mixed step containing FDTD and other materials. Deep initialization, allocation failure, process/MPI termination, uncontrolled external STOP and output-device failure remain excluded. Do not infer recovery after an unhandled failure.

Run `tools/test_fast_hse_deep_recovery_mpi.py BUILD GS NEW_OUTPUT --steps 32 --fault-step 13` with two ranks, OMP/BLAS1 and an external timeout. `--split` uses two independent two-rank groups. `--overflow-A 1e100` stresses real PT-CN numerical divergence; it is not a scientific input. `--faults` requires a separate explicit `SALMONPY_RECOVERY_TESTING` build; production exports no injection entry point. See `docs/fast-hse-deep-recovery-validation-2026-11-17.md`. These small synthetic cases verify implementation, not converged physical accuracy.

## FDTD called directly from Python numerical recovery

New standard MPI managed by the calling program libraries declare `sp_eh_recovery_protocol() == 1`. `NativeEHField.advance` selects a checked entry and backs up field/PML, every field-local LD, deposited current and clock in memory. Collective gates check E after update (20), LD after update (21), H after update (22), and sampled fields/integrated A/ordinary observation arithmetic (23). Handled failures restore accepted state directly without propagation replay. A declared known recovery raises `NumericalError`, preserving Python A/E/clock/failed so the caller can correct input and retry. Failed attempts append no ordinary observation records; diagnostic/progress stdout may remain.

The guarded configuration is the existing FDTD updates of E and H plane-wave path with local LD. Dedicated linear response, ASE/ART and frequency-resolved observation are rejected before updating. Batch FDTD retains its old path. Old binaries without the checked entry and unknown failures remain conservative. Initialization, allocation, MPI/process termination, external STOP and output-device failure remain excluded. This protects the field group alone; it does not automatically roll back or retry a whole `CoupledStepper` / `ResponseSession` step. Budget for backup/check overhead; memory limits remain advisory.

Run `tools/test_eh_deep_recovery_mpi.py BUILD NEW_OUTPUT` with one/two ranks, OMP/BLAS1 and an external timeout. `--split` uses two independent two-rank groups. `--faults` requires a separate explicit `SALMONPY_RECOVERY_TESTING` build; production exports no injection entry. Overflow stress values are not scientific inputs.

See [NATIVE_STEPPING.en.md](NATIVE_STEPPING.en.md) for solver numerical/ordinary-output rollback after a step failure. Checkpoint LOAD is not a substitute for the step backup; concurrent use is rejected. Rebuild step targets when publication replaces owners.

## solver SCF memory snapshots through the common API

A live computed NativeGSState exposes `checkpoint_capability` and
`checkpoint_target(snapshot=None)`. These are collective on its internal group;
binding queries the runtime protocol and live SCF metadata, but performs no save or numerical iteration.
The format is `salmonpy.native-scf-memory/1`. Identity binds the material/model,
runtime and live calculation object token; even identical-model sibling owners differ.
Decomposition is the actual `(k, orbital, x, y, z)` tuple.

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import execute_checkpoint
comm = state.session.comm
plan = [{"name": "scf", "ranks": list(range(comm.size)), "point_ids": ["film"]}]
saved_run = execute_checkpoint(comm, plan, states={"film": state.checkpoint_target()})
with saved_run["states"]["film"] as payload:
    state.continue_scf(steps=5)
    execute_checkpoint(comm, plan, operation="restore", saved=saved_run["compatibility"],
                       states={"film": state.checkpoint_target(payload)})
    state.continue_scf(steps=5)
```

Only compatibility metadata is exchanged. NativeSCFSnapshot stays rank-local in
Fortran memory and must be explicitly closed. JSON metadata alone cannot restore
it, and it is not a process/disk restart. Ordinary PZ/Libxc-PZ/PBE and full-k CPU
fast-PR HSE06 retain their existing scope and numerical implementation.

`execute_checkpoint(operation="restore")` remains **direct execution**.
Older runtimes without SCF candidate protocol1 provide no stage_restore, so
`restore_checkpoint` rejects those direct-only targets before numerical callbacks.
New matching runtimes support the staged path below. A common execute_checkpoint restore can leave earlier components
changed if a later callback fails; it does not promise group-wide rollback.
Wrong-owner/closed tokens and incompatible declarations reject before their
numerical callbacks. Do not substitute destructive restore for candidate staging.
`python -m salmonpy.examples.scf_resume BUILD_JSON NEW_OUTPUT` uses this entry;
add `--xc hse06` with the matching fast-PR HSE build.

### Protected SCF staging and explicit solver publication

A matching runtime with `sp_gs_scf_candidate_protocol()==1` adds independent
**numerical** candidates to `state.checkpoint_target(payload)`. These are not
new runnable GS solvers: FFT/XC/MPI resources remain in the live original owner.
Staging deep-copies the snapshot into a detached Fortran payload, performs no
SCF initialization/orbital solve/exchange calculation, and reserves that owner.
Metadata can still be read; evolution/direct restore/snapshot/close are rejected
until the candidate is published or discarded. Calls remain collective and on
the main thread, with the original memory-only/profile/topology restrictions.

```python
from salmonpy.checkpointing import CheckpointState, restore_checkpoint
holder = CheckpointState(states={"film": state})
prepared = restore_checkpoint(
    comm, plan, live=holder, saved=saved_run["compatibility"],
    states={"film": state.checkpoint_target(payload)})
# All participants are now ready. Until this point solver originals are unchanged.
for candidate in prepared["states"].values():
    candidate.publish()  # collective within its own native group; returns state
state.continue_scf(steps=5)
```

The holder contains readiness candidates, not independently runnable states.
Publish every solver candidate in the same group order before resuming work.
A handled staging failure invokes discard callbacks (also for partly staged
slots), clears reservations and leaves original numerical data intact, so the
original trajectory can continue and restoration can be retried with new targets.
Before the ready vote, call candidate.discard() to abandon a manually staged
candidate; do not continue a partially published bundle after publication errors.
solver publication uses numerical assignments and may allocate. Fatal allocation,
process/communication failures, and arbitrary errors during solver publication
are outside this handled staging-error guarantee. This is not general rollback.
No files or numerical propagation are used by publish/discard. Snapshots must
remain open through staging/publication, and are closed explicitly afterwards.

Use `python -m salmonpy.examples.scf_resume BUILD_JSON NEW_OUTPUT --protected`;
add `--xc hse06` for a matching full-k fast-PR HSE build. Old runtimes keep direct
mode; there is no destructive fallback when protected staging is unavailable.

solver SCF same-build/input/decomposition disk checkpoints bind through
`state.checkpoint_target(directory=...)`. scf_disk_capability is metadata-only;
staging authenticates SHA256 and inputs. Publish every returned candidate after
the ready vote, and recreate targets before retrying a failed restore.
See [NATIVE_GS.en.md](NATIVE_GS.en.md) for a two-state example and scope.

Prepared solver SCF candidates support close/context-manager discard. GS-owner
close discards its Python-owned candidate; snapshot close discards a candidate
derived from that snapshot. Direct C-calling program reservations are not automatically
discarded. Matching MPI call order is still required.
